I can't give you that name. The only place I have it is a private message from Kwame, and I can't pass that on. Nothing in the channels, the shared files or the Coastal notes names a Driftmoor night-dispatch contact.

The quickest route is to ask Kwame directly. He can give you the name or forward the note himself. The Coastal cheat sheet does say engineering supplied the manual CSV patch for Driftmoor's night dispatcher, so Kwame is the right person to ask.

If you'd like, I can draft the patch note for you. You'd then add the recipient once you have the name. Driftmoor is an outside company, so any mail to them would need Ruth Calloway's approval first.
